entities.name: Meloku
entities.description: Soratami ambassador to the human world at Konda's court in Eiganjo and the Minamo School; wizard who assisted Konda's ritual.

entities.name: Konda
entities.description: Daimyo at whose court Meloku served.

entities.name: Soratami
entities.description: Moonfolk whose long-term plan may have been to take over Kamigawa.

entities.name: Kiki-Jiki
entities.description: Akki who stole Meloku's dragon egg.

entities.name: Keiga
entities.description: Dragon to whom the stolen egg belonged.

entities.name: That Which Was Taken
entities.description: Object ripped from the spirit world in the crime that began the Kami War.

entities.name: Kami War
entities.description: War started by the ritual Meloku assisted.

entities.name: Minamo School
entities.description: School of human students of the arcane.

events.summary: Meloku assists Konda with the ritual of ripping That Which Was Taken from the spirit world, the crime that started the Kami War.
events.quote: The wizard Meloku assisted Konda with the ritual of ripping That Which Was Taken from the spirit world

events.summary: Meloku finds a dragon egg and brings it to his palace; Kiki-Jiki, sent by Keiga, later steals it.
events.quote: The egg was later stolen by the akki Kiki-Jiki

relations.quote: ambassador to the human world at daimyo Konda 's court
